title: Speed Triple 1200 RS
description: Representing Triumph's prowess in the Urban Roadster class, the Triumph Speed Triple 1200 RS is delivers muscular mid-range acceleration paired with effortless city maneuvering. A 1200cc powerplant pumps out 150 HP and 120 Nm of torque, striking an optimal balance between fuel economy and spirited passing power. With a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort and a comfortable Upright Neutral layout, it offers fatigue-free ergonomics whether carving traffic or cruising the open highway.
